name: Chat thread
summary: A one-to-one message thread with the other person's photo: bubbles on both sides grouped into runs, a quoted reply, a heart reaction, a read receipt, a typing indicator and a composer with attach and send that adds your message.
use: in a messaging or social app, for a private conversation
a11y: The thread is a log region that can be scrolled with the keyboard, the typing indicator is a status, the quoted reply and reaction have screen-reader text, and Send stays disabled until there is text.
